note: Adapted from the original English description of Hill; the original has all three castes, alate, soldier and worker, and the alate and soldier are used here; the measurements are printed with an asterisk for the decimal point (1*60 is 1.60 mm) and have been written here in mm; the body length is given in the original as 10.00—20.00 mm, an unusually wide span, and is copied as printed.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, pronotum and main wing veins dark brown; antennae and legs pale yellowish brown; pleurites and tergites brown, paler than the head; sternites yellow, tinged dark brown at the spiracles; postclypeus yellowish brown, tinged dark brown at the sides. Head with many small setae, widest anteriorly, slightly narrowing posteriorly; compound eyes very small and protruding; ocelli far removed from the compound eyes; fontanelle very large, broadly oval. Antennae 16—17-segmented (mostly 17); segment 1 long and thick, cylindrical; segment 2 less than half as long as segment 1 and distinctly narrower; segments 3 and 4 very small and closely set; segment 5 globular. Pronotum with pilosity like that of the head, slightly narrower than the head, the anterior margin nearly straight, the anterior corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin broadly rounded with a faint notch in the middle; posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum broadly concave. Wings large, all veins very distinct, the first two veins setiform. Legs long and slender, with numerous small setae. Abdomen with moderately dense small setae. Measurements: body length 10.00—20.00 mm; body length without wings 9.00 mm; head length to the apex of the labrum 1.98 mm; head length to the frontoclypeal suture 1.05 mm; head width 1.60 mm; antenna length 2.54 mm; compound eye 0.24×0.288 mm; compound eye to ocellus 0.160 mm; compound eye to the lower margin of the head 0.144 mm; ocellus long diameter 0.160 mm; pronotum length 0.93 mm, width 1.48—1.55 mm; forewing length 16.00 mm, width 4.27 mm; hind wing length 15.00 mm, width 4.52 mm; hind tibia length 1.86 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, antennae and pronotum deep orange-yellow; legs and abdominal tergites pale buff; anterior margin of the anteclypeus whitish; labrum lemon-yellow; mandibles mahogany. Head elongate-oval, with very few setae; frons wrinkled; postclypeus strongly bilobed, the lobes separated by a deep median groove; mandibles long and slender, each with a broad tooth about at the middle, the tooth of the left mandible larger than that of the right; postmentum long and narrow, its width at the middle a little more than one quarter of the head width. Antennae 16-segmented (very rarely 17); segment 1 long and moderately wide, twice as long as segment 2, slightly widening towards the apex; segment 2 much narrower than segment 1, nearly cylindrical; segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2, narrow at the base but as wide as segment 2 at the apex; segment 4 shortest; segment 5 as long as segment 3; segments 6—11 gradually lengthening. Pronotum small, with few and thick setae, mostly concentrated near the margins, scattered setae present only on the anterior third; the anterior third narrowed and sharply bent upwards, the anterior margin rounded; the posterior margin rounded, slightly undulate in the middle. Mesonotum about as wide as the pronotum, its posterior margin undulate; metanotum distinctly wider than the mesonotum but not longer. Legs long and slender, sparsely setose; claws and spines small and slender.
